subject: Hybrid-tenor renewal + fiscal rollforward checklist
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Cole <emma@helioshealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hybrid-tenor renewal + draft amendment attached

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation I attached a draft amendment (Helios_MAAP_Renewal_Draft_v3.pdf) that balances a multi-year price for predictability with a hybrid-tenor onramp so you only pay for committed capacity as usage ramps. The highlights:

- Year 1: staggered ramp with 40% commit, ability to burst up to 2x for 90 days
- Year 2-3: stepped annual increases with optional early true-up credit
- Auto-renew: opt-out window 60 days prior to renewal to avoid surprise extensions

Quick asks from our side: can procurement confirm target co-term date (Helios fiscal year boundary) and whether you prefer a prepay credit or monthly billing with a committed floor?

I also attached Q3 usage for sizing (usage_report_Q3-2026.csv). If it helps, Karthik and Camila are looped for suggested ramp schedules.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

From: Emma Cole <emma@helioshealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid-tenor renewal + draft amendment attached

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the draft and the usage file. A couple of procurement constraints from our side:

- Helios fiscal year ends 31 Jul; we'd prefer co-terming to 31 Jul 2027 (so year 1 is shorter and aligned to our FY)
- For budget reasons, we need the ability to amortize the contract across two fiscal years (so a hybrid-tenor where Year 1 is prorated and Year 2-3 are full)
- Legal will push back on auto-renew unless there is an explicit opt-out notice; 60 days sounds reasonable but we need that in the amendment language

Can Redwood provide a version that shows the amortized payment schedule and a candidate SOW for billing/usage measurement? Also please include any expected impact to unit pricing if Year 1 is prorated.

Thanks — I can escalate internally if we need to compress the timeline.

—Emma
Emma Cole
Procurement Manager, Helios Health
emma@helioshealth.com
Attachment: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Cole <emma@helioshealth.com>, procurement@helioshealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid-tenor renewal + draft amendment attached

Emma / team —

Appreciate the constraints. Quick internal note (copying what I'll add to the amendment):

1) Fiscal alignment: We can co-term to 2027-07-31. That makes Year 1 a 8-month pro-rated period (Dec 1, 2026 -> Jul 31, 2027) — pricing for Year 1 will be pro-rated on committed capacity.

2) Amortization: Two operational options we recommend:
  - Option A (prepay credit): Helios prepays 60% of Year 1 committed spend and receives a 6% credit applied across FY27 billing; this minimizes unit price and simplifies reconciliation.
  - Option B (amortized invoicing): Monthly invoices with a committed floor and a true-up at co-term; keeps cash flow neutral for Helios but slightly higher unit rate (+3%).

3) Auto-renew: We'll maintain a 60-day opt-out window; legal redlines are expected in the attached redlines-tracked.docx. If they require an explicit signature for renewals we can add an auto-renew confirmation clause with outbound notices 90/60/30 days.

4) Ramp structure: Recommend a three-step ramp (40% -> 70% -> 100%) at 0/6/12 months from co-term start to reduce overcommit risk. Burst lanes remain available for 90-day windows at negotiated surge pricing.

Naomi / Camila — I can produce the amortized payment schedule matrix and a narrow SOW that clarifies metering (token vs. embedding units) if you want me to draft.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hybrid-tenor renewal + draft amendment attached

Emma —

Thanks for the clarity. I've attached a marked-up amendment (redlines-tracked.docx) that:

- Adds the prorated Year 1 schedule tied to 2027-07-31 co-term
- Inserts a billing table showing Option A (prepay credit) and Option B (amortized invoicing) with exact dollar examples using your Q3 usage as baseline
- Clarifies auto-renew opt-out windows and adds a manual signature fallback for renewals if legal insists
- Adds a short SOW paragraph specifying metering: endpoint-level token counts + monthly aggregation; retention rules called out for audit.

Requested next steps:
- Procurement picks Option A or B (or proposes a hybrid)
- Legal returns redlines by EOD 2026-12-08 so we can hit Helios procurement deadline

I attached the redlines doc for visibility.

Best,
